scope: Chinese authored text-only development and fresh-family diagnostic, local Qwen3 1.7B INT4. No real ASR/OCR/native target run.

dev.selection: Inspect all dev pairs; prioritize no material errors, then useful proportional scene organization. Freeze choice before fresh inference; a failing candidate may be chosen for diagnostic only.

evaluation.previous: context-repair-v1 for work/email; scene-rewrite-prompt-v2 examples for prompt/chat. Explicit prior-candidate composite, not installed production.

policies.strict: Current domain validator plus runtime identity/deadline success; rejected proposal retains completed speech cleanup.
policies.envelope: No lexical/content gates; retain empty/truncated/protocol-marker/output-budget checks plus runtime success.
policies.none: Bypass all text validation, including markup/truncation/empty/length checks. Return raw worker text on runtime success, even if empty; timeout/cancellation still cannot publish incomplete/stale session data.

review: All raw outputs and completed cleanup values reviewed against evaluator-only intended text; every policy delivery written in full with proposal/cleanup origin and review. Missed supported repair and invented/context facts remain distinct issues.
acceptance: No new harmful delivered output on fresh matched cases; improved faithful scene-ready delivery, complete review and explicit residual errors. Independent/native release gates remain open.
timing: Group templates and context presence to reduce prefix churn. Generation and strict-check durations separate; model loading separate; no causal product speed claim from subprocess-check timing.
